summary: Kimi API grants newly registered users an RMB 15 voucher, valid for 3 months from issue and applied automatically to API usage before any top-up balance. Eligibility requires registering with a mainland China mobile number.
claim_steps: Register on the Kimi platform with a mainland China mobile number.
The RMB 15 voucher is granted automatically — no manual activation; it deducts before your top-up balance.
Track remaining voucher credit on the Cost Details page in the console.

social_proof.title: Free Trial Benefits — Kimi Help
social_proof.text: Eligible users: New users who register with a mainland China mobile number. Voucher amount: An RMB 15 voucher is granted upon registration. Validity period: The voucher is valid for 3 months from the date it is issued.
